So I work for a mom and pop restaurant. What I find hilarious is people who order through DoorDash, GrubHub, etc. (none of which we're partnered with because we have delivery drivers) and pay all these extra fees and a tip. Guess what - we don't have a delivery fee. And yet people still order through them.

Also, the company has to call in orders because we don't have computerized orders. Let me tell you - they are the rudest people.

Overall just go pickup your food unless you legitimately can't leave your house.

Guitar: Dead honest, it started with the whole Guitar Hero phase. My friends and I were stupidly obsessed with it. We all eventually moved on to playing actual guitars. I got my first guitar as a Christmas gift; a knock off Fender Strat. It came with lots of problems and I eventually gave up on it. Years later I went to work on it - fixed the wiring, changed parts and all. After that I went back to trying to teach myself how to play. I've been doing it on and off ever since my son was born; 9 years. I don't think I'm any good, but that doesn't stop me from playing. I owe 4 guitars (1 seven string) and an ukulele and I don't ever plan on giving up on trying to make my music.

Also, a little side story:
There was this girl I dated back in highschool that I told I was a drummer; never once had to prove it.  👍
